BiblicalUsage: Ahijah tears his new garment into twelve pieces to show Jeroboam the kingdom splitting, and Elisha tears his own clothes in two when Elijah is taken up. The word is the torn piece itself — what is left when something is ripped apart.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God sometimes tears to show what he is doing, and the torn pieces in these stories are his message, not an accident.
